preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= i for i in range(1, n) for p in [int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each parent node p_i+1 is a valid vertex index (1 ≤ p ≤ i) for the i-th edge.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line.split()[1])
preconditions.description: Each edge letter c_i+1 is a lowercase English letter between 'a' and 'v' inclusive.
The input has exactly n lines (1 for n, n-1 for edges).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, one for each vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(out) <= 2 * (n - 1) for out in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a non-negative integer representing the length of a path (0 ≤ length ≤ 2*(n-1)).

postconditions.expression: all(int(out) == max_path_length(v) for v, out in enumerate(stdout.split(), 1))
postconditions.description: For each vertex v, the output integer is the length of the longest simple path in the subtree of v that forms a Dokhtar-kosh string (can be rearranged into a palindrome).
